title: LoopRail
caption: Budgeted, metered payments for autonomous agents
voice: LoopRail gives autonomous agents a spending policy, metered payments, and an auditable record on Solana.

title: The problem
caption: Dozens of API calls need a budget and a clear payment trail.
voice: An agent can make dozens of small API calls. Paying on chain for every call adds overhead, and an agent without spending controls can exceed its budget.

title: The agent loop
caption: Observe. Decide. Reserve. Call. Commit. Record.
voice: Here is a deterministic replay of fifty agent steps. The policy checks each request, reserves the maximum cost, and records the actual result and spend.

title: Replay metrics
caption: 50 simulated steps · 0.058 USDC virtual spend
voice: The fifty step replay reports zero point zero five eight USDC of virtual spend. The dashboard labels this as simulation, with zero on chain settlements.

title: On-chain sandbox payment
caption: One MPP channel · two cumulative vouchers
voice: Now we open a recorded Surfpool sandbox run. One payment channel handled two cumulative vouchers: one thousand two hundred fifty, then seven hundred fifty USDC base units.

title: Confirmed settlement
caption: 0.060 deposited · 0.002 spent · 0.058 refunded
voice: The channel deposited zero point zero six USDC, spent zero point zero zero two, and refunded zero point zero five eight. Its single closing settlement was finalized on the sandbox.

title: Business model and next step
caption: Metered provider payments with a proposed routing fee
voice: LoopRail could earn a small routing fee while providers receive metered USDC. This video shows a simulated agent run and a separate confirmed sandbox payment. A live end to end agent run is the next integration step.
